title: Code on Wages, 2019
snippet: The appropriate Government may fix and revise minimum wages for time work, piece work, and guaranteed minimum wage for employees in scheduled employments.

title: Code on Wages, 2019
snippet: Employees or their legal representatives may apply to the authority for claims arising from unpaid or delayed wages, bonus, or other amounts due; the authority may order payment with interest after inquiry.

title: Payment of Wages Act, 1936
snippet: Wages must be paid on time without unauthorised deductions; limits apply to deductions for fines, absence, damage, or advances. Non-payment can be complained before the authority.

title: Payment of Bonus Act, 1965
snippet: Eligible employees in covered establishments have a right to statutory bonus computed on allocable surplus and salary ceilings; disputes go to labour authorities.

title: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
snippet: EPF contributions are mandatory for covered establishments; employees can raise grievances on non-deposit of PF with the EPFO including assessment and recovery proceedings.

title: Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
snippet: Gratuity is payable on superannuation, resignation after five years, death, or disablement as per the formula in the Act; non-payment can be claimed before the Controlling Authority.

title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947
snippet: Individual disputes on discharge, dismissal, or termination may be raised as industrial disputes; lay-off, retrenchment, and closure require notice, compensation, and often prior permission in larger establishments.

title: Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946
snippet: Certified standing orders govern classification, misconduct, suspension, and termination procedures in scheduled industrial establishments; breach can be agitated in labour forums.

title: Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970
snippet: Principal employers and contractors must pay wages to contract labour as prescribed; default can lead to liability of the principal employer and penalties.

title: Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 1996
snippet: Registered construction workers may access welfare benefits from the Board; wage and safety violations can be pursued under labour and safety laws.

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005
snippet: Households in rural areas have a right to at least 100 days of wage employment; delayed wages attract compensation under the scheme rules.

title: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
snippet: Employers must constitute an Internal Committee where ten or more workers are employed; complaints of workplace sexual harassment are inquired and recommendations include action and relief.

title: Maternity Benefit Act, 1961
snippet: Women employees are entitled to maternity leave, medical bonus, and nursing breaks; dismissal or variation to disadvantage during pregnancy is prohibited except for prescribed reasons.

title: Minimum Wages Act, 1948 (where still applied)
snippet: State Governments notify minimum wages for scheduled employments; paying below the notified rate is an offence and workers can seek recovery through labour officers.

title: Equal Remuneration Act, 1976
snippet: Men and women must receive equal pay for the same work or work of a similar nature; discrimination can be complained to authorities appointed under the Act.

title: Anonymized wage recovery pattern · Pune district
section: Illustrative outcome: direction to pay unpaid wages
snippet: From anonymized legal-literacy notes in Pune district: a shop-floor worker kept ID, appointment letter, salary slips, bank statements showing missed credits, and dated WhatsApp nudges to HR, approached the Assistant Labour Commissioner, and after conciliation and inquiry received a direction for several months of arrears with interest. Not a published judgment; your facts may differ.
forum_visited: Office of the Assistant Labour Commissioner (Pune region)
documents_used: Screenshots of messages to employer about unpaid months

title: Anonymized wage claim pattern · Pune district
section: Illustrative outcome: weak proof, limited relief
snippet: From anonymized notes in Pune district: a daily-wage worker delayed approaching the office for more than a year, had no written employment proof, relied on verbal pay promises, and could not show attendance; the authority recorded the dispute but recovery was poor. Earlier steps and paperwork usually help. Illustrative only—not a court decision.

title: Anonymized gratuity dispute · Mumbai district
section: Illustrative outcome: payment after Controlling Authority application
snippet: Anonymized pattern from Mumbai area: after resignation with five years of service, an employee filed before the Payment of Gratuity Controlling Authority with Form I, last payslips, and relieving letter; the employer paid after notice. Another worker without relieving proof faced longer delay. Patterns for discussion only.
forum_visited: Controlling Authority under Payment of Gratuity Act

title: Anonymized PF grievance · Bengaluru Urban district
section: Illustrative outcome: EPFO follow-up recovered dues
snippet: Anonymized outreach example in Bengaluru Urban: an IT employee raised a non-deposit grievance on the EPFO portal with salary proofs and UAN statement; after field inquiry portions of dues were credited. A colleague who missed filing employer change forms had a slower path. Not a published order; facts vary.
